name: Step-by-step flow
description: On the clean background, a small spaced label and a huge condensed title (one word in orange) punch in, then two to four white step cards stacked down the frame ('STEP 1' label, a bold line, an icon circle). Each step lights up on its word: the icon circle fills orange, a connector draws down from the previous step, and the previous step gets a green check; a black result pill ('→ YOUR OWN NOTES') stamps under the last card.
use_when: A how-to said as a short sequence (do this, then this, then you get that): a method, a recipe, a workflow, a hack in 2-4 steps.

accent.help: word(s) of the title shown in orange

steps.help: [{text, sub, icon, at}] text <= 26 characters; icon from the icon set (default play, sparkle, file, check); at = seconds from the scene start

done.help: result pill after the last step
